summary: Keeps an organization switch stable when another workspace is open in the same browser.
userImpact: An open tab affected by a change to the shared session offers an organization choice before changing the session again.
security: Browser tabs recheck the server session and its permission snapshot after a change to shared browser storage.
documentation: The release notes describe how a previously open workspace tab responds to an organization change.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible application images.
validation: A Chromium regression opens two workspace tabs and verifies that only the explicitly selected tab exchanges the organization session.

customerDocumentation.reason: The existing organization picker is used to resolve a shared browser session change.
